## Data Flow Architecture Analysis

Based on my thorough examination of the codebase, here are the **5-10 most important files to understand the LWC data flow architecture**:

### Core Files to Read

1. **/Users/nick/Projects/Job/cgpm/force-app/main/default/lwc/dataManager/dataManager.js**
   - Central hub for all data loading and state management
   - Implements module-level cache (PROJECT_DATA_CACHE) for cross-component data sharing
   - Manages wire adapters for both Project and Work Item contexts
   - Handles deduplication logic to prevent broadcast loops
   - Provides refresh API for explicit data reloading

2. **/Users/nick/Projects/Job/cgpm/force-app/main/default/lwc/baseComponent/baseComponent.js**
   - Foundation class inherited by all components
   - Manages Lightning Message Service subscriptions (WorkItemEventChannel__c)
   - Provides local storage helpers (setLocalState/getLocalState) for UI state persistence
   - Toast notification utilities (showSuccess, showError, showInfo, showWarning)
   - Error message extraction from Apex exceptions

3. **/Users/nick/Projects/Job/cgpm/force-app/main/default/lwc/workItemCardContainer/workItemCardContainer.js**
   - Primary orchestrator component that demonstrates complete data flow pattern
   - Shows how to handle dataManager events (workitemsload, templatesload)
   - Implements filtered views and expansion state management
   - Demonstrates Lightning Message Service for inter-component communication
   - Shows refresh patterns and local storage usage

4. **/Users/nick/Projects/Job/cgpm/force-app/main/default/classes/WorkItemController.cls**
   - Main Apex controller with @AuraEnabled methods
   - Defines wrapper classes (ProjectDataWrapper, WorkItemWrapper) that structure data for LWC
   - Key methods: getWorkItemsForProject, getWorkItemWithChildren (both @Cacheable)
   - Handles hierarchical data building in Apex before sending to LWC
   - Shows FLS enforcement with stripInaccessible()

5. **/Users/nick/Projects/Job/cgpm/force-app/main/default/lwc/workItemCard/workItemCard.js**
   - Demonstrates consuming wrapped Apex data from parent components
   - Shows inline updates using Lightning record API (updateRecord, deleteRecord)
   - Implements local component state management (edit mode, modals, dropdowns)
   - Demonstrates event bubbling for parent refresh patterns
   - Shows wire adapters for child data (getWorkItemOptionsForProject, getAllowedChildTypeCount)

6. **/Users/nick/Projects/Job/cgpm/force-app/main/default/classes/WorkItemService.cls**
   - Business logic layer called by controllers
   - Implements hierarchical querying with bulkified single query approach
   - Methods: getWorkItemsForProject, getWorkItemWithChildren, getChildrenForParents
   - Shows relationship querying patterns for parent/child lookup fields
   - Demonstrates data transformation before wrapping

7. **/Users/nick/Projects/Job/cgpm/force-app/main/default/lwc/workItemCreateModal/workItemCreateModal.js**
   - Shows external data loading pattern (templates, resources)
   - Demonstrates parallel data loading with Promise.all
   - Shows form reset and modal opening patterns
   - Implements publishevent pattern to notify parent of changes

8. **/Users/nick/Projects/Job/cgpm/force-app/main/default/classes/WorkItemCreateController.cls**
   - Shows different query patterns based on context
   - Implements cascading filtering (project templates → work item types → allowed children)
   - Demonstrates recursive template loading logic
   - Shows caching pattern with @AuraEnabled(Cacheable=true)

9. **/Users/nick/Projects/Job/cgpm/force-app/main/default/messageChannels/WorkItemEventChannel.messageChannel-meta.xml**
   - Defines the Lightning Message Service channel contract
   - Lists all possible action types and data fields
   - Acts as the interface for cross-component communication

### Key Data Flow Patterns Identified

**1. Loading Data**
- DataManager uses @wire decorators for reactive data loading
- getWorkItemsForProject and getWorkItemWithChildren are marked @Cacheable
- Deduplication prevents duplicate broadcasts when data hasn't changed

**2. Updating Data**
- workItemCard uses updateRecord from lightning/uiRecordApi for direct updates
- Changes trigger 'workitemupdate' CustomEvent which bubbles to parent
- Parent component calls dataManager.refresh() to reload from Apex

**3. State Sharing Between Components**
- Module-level PROJECT_DATA_CACHE in dataManager is the single source of truth
- All instances of DataManager register themselves in INSTANCES Set
- broadcastDataChange() notifies all listening instances
- Prevents duplicate Apex calls when multiple components share same projectId

**4. Component Communication**
- Lightning Message Service (WorkItemEventChannel__c) for pub/sub across components
- CustomEvent bubbling for parent-child hierarchical communication
- Local storage (cgpm_prefs_{contextId}) for user UI preferences (view mode, expanded states)

**5. Error Handling Pattern**
- Apex throws AppException with user-friendly messages
- BaseComponent.extractErrorMessage() parses error.body.message
- showError() displays sticky toasts with title and message

This architecture uses a hybrid approach:
- **Module-level cache** for instant data access across components
- **Wire adapters** for reactive reactive updates from Apex
- **Custom events** for hierarchical component communication
- **Lightning Message Service** for cross-component pub/sub
- **Local storage** for client-side UI state persistence
